editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the CMA Foundation exam certified by ICMAI. Master business laws, financial accounting, management, and mathematics across four sections.
editorial.overview: The CMA Foundation certification exam is formally administered by ICMAI and evaluates candidates across four core subjects with completely equal weight percentages allocated to each section. It covers business laws, communication, financial accounting, management principles, business mathematics, and statistical methodologies to test fundamental entry-level competencies required in cost and management accounting professions.
editorial.who_should_take: Aspiring cost and management accounting candidates seeking registration with ICMAI take this exam. It suits beginners pursuing professional accountancy credentials who want to build a foundation in corporate laws, financial accounting principles, managerial concepts, and quantitative methods.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review all the study notes provided directly by ICMAI across all four designated papers to ensure complete coverage. Focus your study efforts equally on each paper since every individual paper holds an exact 25.0 percent weight toward your final preparation. Practice past exam questions consistently, memorize statutory provisions from business laws, and solve mathematical and statistical problems regularly to build your confidence.

domain_guidance.summary: Covers paper 1 focusing extensively on business laws and communication principles. Candidates study the sources of law, the Indian Contracts Act, the Sale of Goods Act, the Negotiable Instruments Act, and business communication principles in detail.
study_focus: Sources of Law and Legislative Process

domain_guidance.summary: Covers paper 2 focusing on the fundamentals of financial accounting. Candidates study accounting principles, bookkeeping entries, ledgers, and the preparation of financial statements as outlined within the official ICMAI curriculum and official guidance documents.

Covers paper 3 focusing entirely on the fundamentals of management. Candidates study management theories, formal organizational structures, along with planning, directing, and controlling functions operating within modern business environments and corporate structures today.

Covers paper 4 focusing on the fundamentals of business mathematics and statistics. Candidates study core arithmetic, advanced algebra, basic calculus, and applied statistical methods utilized in professional business analysis across various industries.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the testing center early with your registration details. Bring required identification and permitted writing instruments for the 720-minute testing session. Manage your time across all four papers effectively.

faq.question_title: How many domains are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam is divided into four domains, which are Paper 1: Fundamentals of Business Laws and Business Communication, Paper 2: Fundamentals of Financial Accounting, Paper 3: Fundamentals of Management, and Paper 4: Fundamentals of Business Mathematics and Statistics, each carrying a 25.0 percent weight.

The official passing score required for the CMA Foundation examination is established at exactly 50 marks. Candidates must successfully meet or exceed this predetermined score threshold in order to pass the evaluation administered directly by ICMAI.

The total allowed duration for the examination is exactly 720 minutes. Candidates should check with ICMAI directly for specific scheduling details and paper-wise time allocations during their scheduled testing session.
The registration fee for the CMA Foundation certification is a ₹1,200 (~$14 USD) registration fee. Candidates should verify current payment methods directly through ICMAI.

methodology.summary: This reference page was compiled successfully utilizing official ICMAI curriculum guides, detailed syllabus documents, and verified examination parameters provided for this specific professional credential.
